thread:
olivia-docs: FYI opened PR #834 — small updates to the migration guide, a new SDK snippet, and two link fixes. Preview failed and security flagged a secret-like token in the example. Can @mark-security and @tara-legal take a look before we merge?

ci-bot: docs-preview job failed: pattern match for secret token in examples/example_async.js. Linkcheck: /old-guide -> 404. Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/ci/834/logs

mark-security: Please paste the snippet. If it's a real key we need a redaction ticket and to scrub history; if it's a sample replace with REDWOOD_API_KEY or process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY.

olivia-docs: Snippet I copied from a test harness: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: "sk_test_ABC123xyz" })
const res = await client.generate("Summarize")
```
I'll change to env var immediately and update the PR description with a note.

tara-legal: Legal needs a one-liner in the PR describing the accidental inclusion and confirming no customer PII. We'll sign off once that's in. Also prefer the changelog to mention the redaction ticket id.

rafa-devex: I'll fix the broken link and lint error. @olivia-docs push your snippet change and I'll queue a redeploy. Recommend merging after sign-offs and not during the noon deploy window.

olivia-docs: Pushed commit: replaced literal with process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, added comment about setting env var, added PR note about accidental inclusion and statement re: no customer PII. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834

ci-bot: redeploy queued by rafa-devex.

ci-bot: docs-preview succeeded ✅ https://deploy-previews.redwood.com/834

mark-security: Confirmed change and ran a quick repo grep; no live key detected. Filed redaction ticket REDACT-2026-055 and added entry to internals/redactions/REDACT-2026-055.md. Approve from security.

tara-legal: Legal approves; please include the sentence: "Sanitized sample SDK key in migration guide; redaction recorded (REDACT-2026-055)." in the changelog.

devops-bot: Merging scheduled by rafa-devex at 16:45 UTC to avoid peak deploys. Merge will include changelog update and redaction note.

olivia-docs: Thanks all — will follow up with a short contributor checklist to avoid copying test files into examples.
